title: docs: add board screenshot to date_time SETUP.md step 4
author: app/claude
body:
## Summary

- Added `![Date & Time displayed on a Vestaboard](./board-display.png)` after the prose in step 4 ("View on Your Board") of `plugins/date_time/docs/SETUP.md`
- `board-display.png` already existed on disk; the image reference was simply missing from the step
- Matches the canonical format used by the Countdown plugin's SETUP.md

One line added to `plugins/date_time/docs/SETUP.md` — no logic, no config, no tests needed.

## Confidence

High. The image file exists, the change is mechanical, and it exactly mirrors the pattern the issue references in the Countdown SETUP.md.

**Reviewer: nothing to validate beyond "does the image render correctly in the rendered Markdown view."**

Closes #1029

title: docs: move board-display.png to canonical step 4 in date_time SETUP.md
author: app/claude
body:
## Summary

- Removes `![Date & Time Display](./board-display.png)` from after the one-sentence description at the top of `plugins/date_time/docs/SETUP.md`
- Adds it at the end of the `### 4. View on your board` section — the canonical position per `CLAUDE.md` and `plugins/countdown/docs/SETUP.md`
- The image file already existed; this is a pure move, not an addition

## What I checked

- Confirmed the image appears exactly once in the file after this change
- Verified the image file exists at `plugins/date_time/docs/board-display.png`
- Compared structure against `plugins/countdown/docs/SETUP.md` as the canonical reference

## What a reviewer should check

- The rendered preview looks correct in GitHub's markdown viewer — image appears at the bottom of step 4, not at the top of the file

Closes #1036
